app_shell.layout: authenticated shell with role-aware navigation and page-level guards
notes: No frontend route is designed for live rule invocation because the API contract explicitly excludes a business rule invocation endpoint.
No generic browse/list policies or rules screens are included because the API contract has no list endpoints.
No destructive purge screen is included because the API contract has no delete/purge endpoint.

pages.title: POV Overview
pages.purpose: Entry point summarizing the supported POV capabilities and linking users into audit, search, analytics, operations, external outcomes, and setup workflows.
data_needed: Role/permission context from frontend auth state
error_states: Forbidden state if entire app access is denied

pages.title: Request Lookup
pages.purpose: Allow privileged users to retrieve one execution audit record by request ID or correlation ID.
data_needed: optional tenant_id only for frontend scoping/context; correlation/request lookup endpoints do not both require it

api_endpoints.usage: Used when lookup mode is request ID.
Used when lookup mode is correlation ID.

user_actions: Toggle lookup mode between request ID and correlation ID

pages.title: Execution Request Detail
pages.purpose: Show the full stored audit record for a single execution request, including request/response payloads, all rule-step details, ingestion metadata, and retention metadata.
data_needed: Optional policy metadata for context links

api_endpoints.usage: Optional retention edit action from privileged operations control on this page.

loading_states: Section skeletons for JSON/rule-step panels during refetch
error_states: PATCH save failure for retention update

pages.title: Execution Timeline
pages.purpose: Present the chronological sequence of rule-step events for a request in a timeline/table format optimized for step-by-step investigation.

pages.title: Policy Context
pages.purpose: Provide policy and ordered rule-definition context for a request investigation or analytics interpretation.
user_actions: Review policy status and publish date

pages.title: Content Search
pages.purpose: Search execution logs by terms or phrases found inside payloads, outcomes, or rule-step content.

pages.title: Structured Filter Search
pages.purpose: Filter execution requests by structured criteria supported by the API: tenant, policy, version, date range, final outcome, and one payload_summary field/value pair.
error_states: 400 invalid filter request if any required field missing

pages.title: Rule Condition Search
pages.purpose: Find requests where a specified rule step occurred with a given status and decision during a date range.

pages.title: Analytics Dashboard
pages.purpose: Visualize policy outcome trends and compare policy-version impact using the exact analytics endpoints provided by the API.
data_needed: one or more policy_versions for daily trends
exactly two policy_versions for impact comparison

api_endpoints.usage: Trend charts for one or more selected versions.
Side-by-side impact comparison when exactly two versions are selected.
Top rejection reasons for one selected version.

loading_states: Per-panel loading states so one chart can load independently
error_states: Empty analytics states when no records exist
notes: Because there is no endpoint for AI/LLM-generated insights, any insight callout must be deterministic client-side copy derived from returned metrics, not generative backend functionality.
Because there is no list-policies endpoint, policy and version values must be entered manually or navigated in from an existing context.

pages.title: External Outcomes
pages.purpose: Show recent externally invoked request outcomes and response payloads without exposing rule-step internals.

pages.title: Ingestion Monitoring
pages.purpose: Monitor requests that are still being ingested, failed, or partially logged.
user_actions: Open request detail for a selected request
error_states: Empty state when no problem/in-flight requests exist

pages.title: Retention Planning
pages.purpose: Help operations users understand retention backlog and identify purge-eligible requests, with supported retention metadata updates only.
data_needed: selected request retention metadata for edit

api_endpoints.usage: List purge candidates as of a date.
Edit one request's retention metadata from results or detail context.

user_actions: Edit retention metadata for one request
loading_states: Independent loading states for summary and candidates
Inline save spinner for retention edits
error_states: 404 if updating a request that no longer exists
notes: The frontend must not present a 'Purge Now' action because the API contract does not provide deletion/purge execution.

pages.title: Create Policy
pages.purpose: Allow POV admins to seed policy metadata needed for policy context and analytics demonstrations.
user_actions: Navigate to related create rule or policy context pages

pages.title: Create Rule
pages.purpose: Allow POV admins to seed rule metadata referenced by policy context and execution steps.

pages.title: Create Execution Request
pages.purpose: Allow POV admins to seed an execution audit document for demo purposes.
data_needed: Execution request create form fields including payloads, status, ingestion metadata, retention metadata, optional embedded steps
user_actions: Enter execution request metadata and payloads
Navigate to request detail or append step

pages.title: Append Rule Step
pages.purpose: Append an incremental rule-step event to an existing execution request to demonstrate asynchronous/incremental logging.
data_needed: optional update_fields such as status/final outcome/response payload

api_endpoints.usage: Append rule step and update related fields.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No live rule invocation endpoint exists in the authoritative API.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Do not design a screen that submits business input to execute a policy/rule. External outcomes can only review stored outcomes, not trigger them.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No generic list policies or list rules endpoint exists.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Forms and analytics criteria must use manual entry, route context, or seeded IDs rather than dropdowns populated from backend listing APIs.
Retention screens may identify purge candidates and edit retention metadata, but cannot execute destructive purge.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No analytics endpoint exists for arbitrary dashboards beyond the three provided analytics queries.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Dashboard scope must remain limited to daily trends, two-version impact comparison, and rejection reason breakdown.
Any 'insights' displayed must be simple client-side interpretations of available metrics, clearly not an AI backend feature.
